caption: The drawing depicts a large, cylindrical stoneware jar with a slightly wider rounded top and a thick rim. The jar is primarily tan or light brown in color, with variations in shading that suggest a textured, uneven surface. There are two small, rounded handles on opposite sides near the top, each accented with a blue color. Blue decorative markings, resembling swirls or brushstrokes, appear on the upper left portion of the jar’s front. Above these markings, the text "C. CROLIUS NEW YORK" is inscribed in blue. The jar sits on a light neutral or off-white background. The artist’s signature, "John Harantino," is located in the lower right corner of the drawing.
title: Jar
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
